name: HARUNA MIDDLE
_note: Section of the real Mount Haruna pass, imported from OpenStreetMap. The run starts at the top of the mountain, so the first section is the upper one. Re-bake with: node tools/bake-route.mjs tools/specs/haruna-middle.json --osm-file tools/osm/haruna-downhill.osm.json --out public/routes/haruna-middle.json
